translation: YHWH mi Elohim ⟨en⟩ ti he buscado refugio; sálvame de todos mis perseguidores y ⟨⟩ rescátame

tokens.rationale: The prepositional prefix בְְ requires the pronoun 'ti' in Spanish
The root חסה means 'to seek refuge', reflecting the act of taking shelter
Imperative form הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי from the root ישע 'to save'
The preposition מִן 'from' combined with the collective כָּל 'all'
Participle form רֹדְפַי from the root רדף 'to pursue'
The conjunction וְ 'and' with imperative הַצֵּל 'deliver' - ⟨⟩ marks the missing direct object marker
